spec: BUG-421: Order CSV export shows dates in US format.
An order placed on 9 March 2026 appears as 03/09/2026 in the export and Dutch customers read it as 3 September.
Expected: the ordered_at column uses ISO 8601 (YYYY-MM-DD).

expect.check: the change is minimal: only the date formatting and its test expectations change, no refactors or drive-by edits
